crops.feature: diagram: cab, cab door, first windows, door 1
crops.reading: Diagram cab car: yellow face with a protruding bumper, white cab door with a split window, a white gap, then one black band holding oval, big, oval windows ahead of door 1 (light blue double door); navy lower band with a dotted fade under the cab; a yellow first-class stripe at the cantrail over the first bay; shoe beam on the leading bogie.

crops.feature: diagram: DMSO inner end and TSO first windows
crops.reading: Diagram coupled ends: DMSO ends big, big, small window; bellows; TSO starts small, big, big; navy band and underframe continuous.

Whole face yellow up to an arched top edge, white dome above with a thin orange line between; two screens in one dark surround split by a pillar; full-width black band below with white 465014 at right; two black-rimmed lamp boxes low; bumper of two side blocks and a lower centre beam, coupler recess between.
crops.secondReader: second reader agrees (arch, thin salmon-orange line, two blocks and lower centre beam)

crops.reading: Two near-equal panes, top outer corners rounded, rubber gaskets, thin gold heater lines inside; left wiper nearly upright, right wiper diagonal toward the pillar, pivots on the band's top edge.

crops.feature: top of the face: yellow arch, line, white dome
crops.reading: Yellow arch highest at the centre, dropping at both corners; a thin orange line along its top edge; white roof dome above.
465014 in white bold sans on the black band, right of centre, the band's lower edge ribbed.
Black band the full width under the screens, two seams marking a centre plate, rounded lower outer corners.
One long black-rimmed box: outboard a pale upright rectangle, then a round clear headlamp, then a round red LED tail (lit) inboard.
crops.secondReader: second reader: small pale upright rectangle, round clear lamp, lit red dot cluster at right: agrees

crops.reading: Right box, unlit: red blob inboard (left), clear lamp outboard of it; the outer end too dim to read.

crops.feature: right lamp box from the right, tail lit
crops.reading: Right box from the right: red tail lit inboard, clear headlamp, then a small upright amber/cream rectangle outboard: the order is mirrored from the left box.
crops.secondReader: second reader: red lit at left, clear lamp, small tall amber/clear rectangle at far right: agrees (mirrored order)

crops.feature: bumper blocks, beam and coupler recess
crops.reading: Two large angular yellow blocks with chamfered outer corners, a lower flatter yellow beam between at the top, dark recess and coupler below the beam.
White cab door, tall window with a mid bar, a black seal on its front edge; white strip to the yellow corner; dot fade below its rear edge; door not contrasting.
Two light blue leaves (A2, A1), each one tall round-ended window; leaves from just under the cantrail line to the body bottom, the lower part curving out (tumblehome); navy band either side.
crops.secondReader: second reader: two pale-blue leaves, one tall window each, run almost to the bottom, lower part curving out: agrees

crops.feature: windows between cab door and door 1
crops.reading: Black band: narrow pill window, wide window with a hopper top, narrow pill window, between the cab door and door 1.

crops.feature: lower bodyside: navy band and dot fade at the cab end
crops.reading: Navy lower band fading to white toward the cab through halftone dots that shrink toward the front; the fade's top edge runs level then slopes down to the front.
crops.secondReader: second reader: dots larger toward the black, thinning rightward (toward the cab), upper edge slopes down: agrees

crops.reading: White roof, grey gutter line, thin orange line just under it running the length of the car.
Lowercase wordmark on the white strip under the windows, 'south' darker, the rest paler blue-grey (blurred; s-wordmark-007 reads 'southeastern.').
crops.secondReader: second reader read 'southern' (blur); settled by the sharper s-wordmark-007 crop: 'southeastern.'

crops.reading: Dark outside-framed bogie with coil springs and dampers, shoe gear behind.

crops.feature: cab corner and cab door, three-quarter
crops.reading: Three-quarter cab corner: the yellow wraps only the rounded corner; white cab door close behind with its black front seal; dots under it on the navy skirt.

crops.feature: door 2, car end and the TSO beyond
crops.reading: Door 2 near the car end, gangway bellows, the TSO beyond in the same livery.
